heading.name: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Savoy

section.heading: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The SavoyGet the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Savoy
section.paragraph:
Originally opened in 1889, the world-famous Savoy Hotel is situated on the banks of the Thames and less than 5 minutes' walk from The British Museum and The Royal Opera House. The hotel was once visited by the likes of Sir Winston Churchill, Frank Sinatra and Katherine Hepburn.
Perfectly situated in heart of the exciting city of London, The Savoy is only 5 minutes’ walk from Covent Garden, the hotel is just 20 minutes’ journey by public transport from the ultimate designer shopping destinations of Knightsbridge and Mayfair.
With elegant marble bathrooms, The Savoy’s 195 guest rooms and 73 suites are decorated in either Edwardian or Art Deco style, blending comfort and elegance with discreet technology. Many rooms afford breath-taking views over the River Thames.
At The Savoy you will find some of the London’s best-known restaurants and bars. Gallery, a vibrant space at the heart of the hotel is perfect for drinking and dining. The beautiful space seamlessly integrates contemporary style whilst remaining true to our much loved heritage. Innovative menus, carefully crafted by our talented culinary team, entice you in showcasing traditional recipes with a modern twist. Take the Savoy’s legendary afternoon tea in Gallery, in addition to breakfast, coffee, lunch, cocktail hour and dinner. During your visit, experience one of our three Gordon Ramsay restaurants, with a choice from Savoy Grill, The River Restaurant and Restaurant 1890. And make sure to spend time in the American Bar (widely regarded as one of the world’s best hotel bars) for a classic cocktail, or enjoy a character cocktail in the theatrical Beaufort Bar.Originally opened in 1889, the world-famous Savoy Hotel is situated on the banks of the Thames and less than 5 minutes' walk from The British Museum and The Royal Opera House.
